rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for the activity of pressing clothes.
Use this noun phrase for clothes that are waiting to be ironed.

example.english: These are the clothes waiting for ironing.
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 hai6 jiu3 wan6 ge3 saam1

rows.note: Use this noun phrase for clothes that have already been ironed and are ready to be put away.

example.english: I put the clothes away after ironing.
example.traditional: 熨好咗嘅衫，我放晒入櫃桶。
example.jyutping: wan6 hou2 zo2 ge3 saam1 ngo5 fong3 saai3 jap6 gwai6 tung2
